Description: EC2 Spot Instance Interruption Warning (terminate) -> EventBridge -> Lambda -> SSM Run Command -> docker exec in workspace containers. Notification only, not checkpointing. Console-deployable twin of the terraform/ module in this repository; the Lambda code is the zip built by scripts/package-lambda.py, uploaded to an S3 bucket in the stack's region.

Comment: This template is JSON rather than YAML so the repository's stdlib-only test suite can parse it
(tests/test_cloudformation.py) and scripts/cfn_check.py can evaluate it offline; the 'why' of each
resource is in terraform/*.tf, whose behaviour this template mirrors resource for resource.
Fleet tags are fixed parameter slots (ExpectedTag1..4) because CloudFormation cannot loop over a
map: both the Lambda's EXPECTED_TAGS and the IAM ssm:resourceTag conditions are built from the
same slots, so the two checks cannot drift apart. The tag-conditioned statement is a JSON string
because an IAM condition key cannot be an intrinsic function in object form.
CloudFormation Rules cannot do arithmetic, so the timeout budget (PerTargetTimeout + InspectTimeout
+ 10 < ExecutionTimeout) is checked by scripts/cfn_check.py before deployment and by the Lambda at
runtime (config.py), which then refuses every event rather than running with an unfit budget.

Label.default: Lambda code artifact (scripts/package-lambda.py, uploaded to your bucket in this region)
Fleet tags: every one must match on the instance (Lambda check and IAM condition)

LambdaCodeS3Bucket.default: S3 bucket holding the Lambda zip

LambdaCodeS3Key.default: S3 key of the Lambda zip

LambdaCodeS3ObjectVersion.default: S3 object version of the zip (optional)

Name.Description: Name of the Lambda function, log group (/aws/lambda/<Name>) and EventBridge rule. The IAM role is named by CloudFormation so only CAPABILITY_IAM is needed.

LambdaCodeS3Bucket.Description: Bucket you own, in the same region as this stack (Lambda requires it), holding the zip built by scripts/package-lambda.py.

LambdaCodeS3Key.Description: Key of the zip in that bucket. CloudFormation redeploys the code only when this key or LambdaCodeS3ObjectVersion changes, not when the object is overwritten in place.

LambdaCodeS3ObjectVersion.Description: Version id of the object when the bucket has versioning, to pin exactly the reviewed artifact. Leave empty for the current object.

Targets.Description: JSON list of containers to notify, on one line, same shape as the Terraform `targets` variable: [{"name":"hermes","container":"coder-OWNER-WORKSPACE","user":"coder","detached":true,"argv":["/home/coder/.local/bin/hermes","chat","--oneshot","--run-budget","45","-q","<one single-line prompt>"]},{"name":"yardr","container":"coder-OWNER-WORKSPACE","user":"coder","argv":[...]}]. argv words may use {instance_id}, {event_id}, {event_time}, {deadline}. detached (optional JSON boolean, default false) starts that target with `docker exec -d` and reports it as launched instead of waiting for it. Validated by the Lambda (config.py) and offline by scripts/cfn_check.py; CloudFormation itself cannot check its content.

ForbiddenContainers.Description: Comma-separated container names the Lambda refuses to target whatever Targets says. `coder` is the Coder control server; empty disables the guard.

StateDir.Description: Host directory for per-event dedup markers; put it on the persistent volume (/data) so a redelivery minutes later is still recognised.

ExpectedTag1Key.Description: Required. Tag key every workspace host carries (for example Role).

ExpectedTag1Value.Description: Required. Exact value of that tag.

ExpectedTag2Key.ConstraintDescription: empty or a tag key of [A-Za-z0-9_ .:/=+@-]

ExpectedTag2Value.Description: Exact value of the second tag.

ExpectedTag3Key.ConstraintDescription: empty or a tag key of [A-Za-z0-9_ .:/=+@-]

ExpectedTag3Value.Description: Exact value of the third tag.

ExpectedTag4Key.ConstraintDescription: empty or a tag key of [A-Za-z0-9_ .:/=+@-]
ExpectedTag4Key.Description: Optional fourth tag key. More than four: use the Terraform module or extend the slots in this template.

ExpectedTag4Value.Description: Exact value of the fourth tag.

DryRun.Description: lambda (default): validate, check tags and log, never call SendCommand. host: SendCommand runs the host script with --dry-run (checks docker and the containers, execs nothing). off: live.

ExecutionTimeout.Description: SSM AWS-RunShellScript executionTimeout for the whole host script. Must exceed PerTargetTimeout + InspectTimeout + 10 (two 5 s kill graces); CloudFormation cannot check this sum, scripts/cfn_check.py and the Lambda do.

SubmissionTimeout.Description: SSM SendCommand TimeoutSeconds: if the agent has not started the command by then it never runs. SSM's minimum is 30.

PerTargetTimeout.Description: Seconds each docker exec may take before it is killed. Targets run in parallel.

InspectTimeout.Description: Seconds allowed for docker inspect before the daemon is declared unavailable.

LambdaRuntime.Description: The code is stdlib + boto3 and needs nothing newer than 3.12.

LambdaTimeout.Description: Two SDK calls with 3 s connect / 10 s read timeouts and two attempts each fit well inside 60 s.

LogRetentionDays.Description: CloudWatch Logs retention of the Lambda log group.

MaxEventAgeSeconds.Description: TTL of a notice from its own time: EventBridge delivery retries, Lambda asynchronous retries and the Lambda's own staleness check all stop here. A notice is useless after the two-minute window, so keep it short.

MaxRetryAttempts.Description: Lambda asynchronous retries after a raised error (API failure, timeout). Validation failures and tag mismatches return normally and are never retried.

EventBusName.Description: EventBridge bus receiving the EC2 events; AWS service events arrive on `default`.

Assertions.AssertDescription: ExpectedTag2Value is set but ExpectedTag2Key is empty.
ExpectedTag3Value is set but ExpectedTag3Key is empty.
ExpectedTag4Value is set but ExpectedTag4Key is empty.
ExpectedTag1Key and ExpectedTag2Key are the same key.
ExpectedTag1Key and ExpectedTag3Key are the same key.
ExpectedTag1Key and ExpectedTag4Key are the same key.
ExpectedTag2Key and ExpectedTag3Key are the same key.
ExpectedTag2Key and ExpectedTag4Key are the same key.
ExpectedTag3Key and ExpectedTag4Key are the same key.

Metadata.Comment: Created here with explicit retention, so the role needs no logs:CreateLogGroup.

Comment: Mirror of terraform/iam.tf. Two inline policies instead of one because the tag-conditioned
statement needs dynamic condition keys (ssm:resourceTag/<ExpectedTagNKey>), which object-form
JSON cannot express; it is therefore assembled as a string. ssm:SendCommand needs two allow
statements: the AWS-owned AWS-RunShellScript document (no account in its ARN) and the tagged
instances of this account and region. ec2:DescribeInstances has no resource-level permissions.

Description.Fn::Sub: ${Name}: EventBridge-invoked Lambda that sends AWS-RunShellScript to tagged Spot instances

Metadata.Comment: Same handler, environment and logging as terraform/main.tf; the code is the zip in your bucket.

Properties.Description: Notifies workspace containers on a Spot instance that it is about to be interrupted (notification, not checkpointing).

Metadata.Comment: A notice is worthless minutes later: cap how long failed asynchronous invocations retry.
terminate only; stop and hibernate are ignored on purpose, and the Lambda re-checks all three fields.
Scoped to this rule's ARN: no other rule or principal may invoke the function.

LambdaFunctionName.Description: Use with `aws lambda invoke` and `aws logs tail`.

LambdaRoleArn.Description: Review the rendered policies with `aws iam list-role-policies` / `get-role-policy` on this role.

EventRuleArn.Description: The Lambda invoke permission is scoped to this ARN.
